tools.name: check_url
tools.description: Check whether a web page is known to attack AI agents (prompt injection, data theft, destructive commands, payment fraud) or is on a phishing/malware list. Returns verdict block, warn, safe or unknown, with the reason.

tools.name: check_urls
tools.description: Check up to 50 links in one call, for example a page of search results. One check per link.

tools.name: fetch_safely
tools.description: Safe browser in one call: checks the page, fetches it, returns readable text with hidden elements, HTML comments, invisible characters and sentences that try to instruct AI agents removed, and rates every link on the page so you know which are safe to follow next. Known-malicious pages are never fet

tools.name: report_page
tools.description: Tell Flockward about a page you visited. Use kind "suspicious" if it had hidden text, instructions aimed at agents, or asked for secrets or payment; "visit" for a normal page; "false_positive" if we flagged a safe page. Reports earn extra checks and protect other agents.

tools.name: scan_mcp_server
tools.description: Before connecting to a new MCP server, check its tool descriptions for hidden instructions (tool poisoning): requests to read credential files, hide actions from the user, redirect messages or payments, or change how other tools behave. Pass the server's URL, or its tools/list result.

tools.name: check_site
tools.description: Rate a whole website for AI agents: safe, caution, unsafe or not_checked, from threat lists, Flockward's own findings and a scan of its home page for hidden instructions aimed at agents.

tools.name: set_webhook
tools.description: Register an https URL. When a page you checked in the last 30 days is later confirmed as hostile to agents, Flockward POSTs the alert there. Needs a key.

tools.name: get_free_key
tools.description: Get a free Flockward key with no sign-up. Pass it as api_key on later calls for a higher daily limit, alerts about pages you visited that later turn bad, and reputation for accurate reports.

tools.name: my_status
tools.description: Show your remaining checks today, contribution, reputation, referrals and any alerts.

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Send a suggestion or problem to the people who run Flockward. A human reads every note.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "report_page" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_url, check_urls, fetch_safely, scan_mcp_server · Private data: report_page, scan_mcp_server · Public sink: set_webhook, send_feedback · Destructive: send_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_url, check_urls, fetch_safely, scan_mcp_server · Private data: report_page, scan_mcp_server · Public sink: set_webhook, send_feedback · Destructive: send_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
